title: Formal functions at a geometric stalk for proper algebraic spaces
statement:
Let $Y$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth] and $f:X\to Y$ a proper morphism of algebraic spaces [def-trf-algebraic-space, lem-sfb-space-flat-proper-fp-locality]. Proper means separated, of finite type and universally closed. Let $F$ be a coherent module on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$: it is quasi-coherent [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module] and there is a jointly surjective family of affine etale charts $\operatorname{Spec}B_i\to X$ with $B_i$ Noetherian and $F$ associated on each chart to a finitely generated $B_i$-module [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Let $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$ be a geometric point, with $\Omega$ algebraically closed [def-weil-geometric-point], and use geometric stalks [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Put $A=\mathcal O_{Y,\bar y}$ and let $\mathfrak m$ be its maximal ideal. Then $A$ is a Noetherian local ring. Let $c:\operatorname{Spec}A\to Y$ be the canonical morphism: for any affine pointed etale neighbourhood $(U,\bar u)$ of $\bar y$ it is the composite of $U\to Y$ with the map $\operatorname{Spec}A\to U$ given by the colimit map $\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)\to A$, and it does not depend on $(U,\bar u)$. For $n\geq1$ set $X_n=X\times_Y\operatorname{Spec}(A/\mathfrak m^n)$, formed along $c$ restricted to $\operatorname{Spec}(A/\mathfrak m^n)$, with projection $i_n:X_n\to X$, and $F_n=i_n^*F$, using algebraic-space fibre products and tensor pullback [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers, def-trf-space-etale-module-functors, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Write $R^qf_*F$ for right derived module direct image on the small etale ringed sites, computed by an injective resolution in module sheaves [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Write $H^q(X_n,F_n)$ for right derived global sections on the same ringed site. For every integer $q\geq0$, with $M=(R^qf_*F)_{\bar y}$, there is a canonical isomorphism of $\widehat A$-modules
$$\widehat M=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}M/\mathfrak m^nM\ \simeq\ \varprojlim_{n\geq1}H^q(X_n,F_n),\qquad \widehat A=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}A/\mathfrak m^n.$$
Here completion is [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and the cohomology transition maps are restriction along $X_n\hookrightarrow X_{n+1}$ followed by $F_{n+1}|_{X_n}\simeq F_n$.

source.place: Tag 08B1 (lemma-formal-functions-stalk); Noetherianity of A is the first observation of its proof, using spaces-properties.tex Tag 08AH (lemma-Noetherian-local-ring-Noetherian), locally on Y.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-space-strict-local-cohomology-comparison] to $f,F,\bar y$: properness supplies separatedness and finite type. With $X_A=X\times_Y\operatorname{Spec}A$, projections $h,f_A$ and $F_A=h^*F$, this gives a Noetherian local ring $A$, coherent $F_A$, and the canonical $A$-linear isomorphism $\alpha:M\xrightarrow{\sim}N:=H^q(X_A,F_A)$. The comparison is induced by the canonical pointed-neighbourhood maps, so it uses the same $c$ as the statement. No replacement of the geometric stalk by an ordinary Zariski stalk is made.

source.place: Tag 08B1, proof, first two paragraphs, strict-local reduction.

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-space-flat-proper-fp-locality], $f_A$ is proper. The universal property of fibre products [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers] gives $X_A\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}(A/\mathfrak m^n)\simeq X\times_Y\operatorname{Spec}(A/\mathfrak m^n)=X_n$: both objects represent triples with the identical compatibility over $Y$. Tensor pullback [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors] identifies the restriction of $F_A$ with $F_n$; on charts the identification is $(P\otimes_B C)\otimes_C D\simeq P\otimes_B D$, sending $(p\otimes c)\otimes d$ to $p\otimes cd$. These maps commute with the quotient maps $A/\mathfrak m^{n+1}\to A/\mathfrak m^n$, since both composites send this tensor to the same tensor after reduction. Thus the towers, including their restriction maps, are canonically identified.

source.place: Tag 08B1, proof, canonical identifications X_n=X_n\prime; spaces-morphisms.tex Tag 04WP (lemma-base-change-proper).

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-space-affine-formal-functions] to the Noetherian ring $A$, ideal $\mathfrak m$, proper $f_A$ and coherent $F_A$. It gives $\widehat N\xrightarrow{\sim}\varprojlim_nH^q(X_n,F_n)$ with the transition maps identified in step 2. The $A$-linear isomorphism $\alpha$ from step 1 sends $\mathfrak m^nM$ onto $\mathfrak m^nN$, so induces compatible isomorphisms $M/\mathfrak m^nM\simeq N/\mathfrak m^nN$. Taking the inverse limit and composing yields the asserted isomorphism. It is $\widehat A$-linear because at coordinate $n$ both maps respect the $A/\mathfrak m^n$ action; hence they respect coordinatewise multiplication by every compatible sequence $(a_n)_n\in\widehat A$. The maps used are the specified cohomological restrictions and canonical base-change comparison, which proves canonicity.
